# Pearltrees

> Pearltrees is an AI-powered knowledge organization platform that enables users to curate, organize, and share collections of web content with collaborative features and generative AI integration.

Based in Paris, France, Pearltrees combines visual knowledge management with cutting-edge AI capabilities including Spirit 1.0 language models, serving both individual users and educational institutions. The platform emphasizes content curation, collaborative learning, and intelligent content discovery.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI Integration
- Spirit 1.0 Language Model
- Knowledge Organization
- Collaborative Platform
- Pearltrees Education
- AI-Powered Features
- Content Curation
- Cloud Technologies
- Data Privacy & GDPR
- Premium Subscriptions
- Teaching Assistants
- Mobile Applications
- Pedagogical Tools
- Content Discovery
